identity_rule: a residue number alone is never an identity key

statuses.definition: residue carries a GPCRdb generic number
residue maps to a UniProt position but has no generic number
residue lies in a region GPCRdb does not number generically (N-terminus, C-tail, some loops)
statuses.note: this is an expected absence, NOT a mapping failure

statuses.definition: residue lies in a generic-numberable segment yet carries no generic number
statuses.note: this IS a mapping failure and blocks generic aggregation for the observation

statuses.definition: residue belongs to a fusion partner or construct region, not the receptor

critical_distinction: A missing generic number in an N-terminus or loop and a missing generic number on a TM core residue are NOT the same null. The first is non_generic_numberable_region; the second is expected_generic_but_unmapped and is a defect.
